profile.org_note: Single-market, founder-run private builder with one corporate office (1314 N Durham Dr, Suite 200, Houston 77008) and no divisions. The company site names only the founder, Ken Williams; no land, finance or operations executive is published anywhere I could open, so land and financing decisions should be assumed to sit with Williams. Texas Comptroller records show Kenneth B. Williams as member or manager of the controlling entities at that address (Nuway Homes, LLC, which is general partner of Nuway Homes Texas, L.P.; Nuway Holdings, L.L.C.; Lexington 26 GP, L.L.C., general partner of Lexington 26, L.P.) and as registered agent of the two partnerships. Community pages publish only on-site sales counsellors.
profile.email_pattern: first initial + last name @colinahomes.com (e.g. kwilliams@, jbourelle@, lgarcia@)
profile.summary: Private, founder-owned entry-level builder working only in greater Houston, founded 2007 by Ken Williams; the site lists 14 communities (4 marked new or coming, 2 in close-out) with homes advertised from $190,990 and most product in the $200s to $300s. A conventional for-sale builder and a plausible, if small, land-banking customer: it mainly takes finished lots in third-party master plans (five current communities are Land Tejas developments) and discloses nothing about lot counts, lenders or capital partners. Size check: the Builder 100 figures in the spine (540 closings, $84M) imply about $156K a home, below the company's own lowest advertised price, so Pro Builder's roughly $124M (about $229K a home) looks the more consistent revenue number.

people.note: Owner and sole named executive; the only person Domain can call on for land and finance from public sources. The site calls him founder (2007); it gives no CEO or president title. Builder Online's Builder 100 profile lists 'Kenneth Williams' as CEO, but I saw that only in a search snippet (the page returned 403), so the CEO title is unconfirmed. Texas Comptroller franchise-tax records (opened this run) list Kenneth B. Williams as member of Nuway Homes, LLC (general partner of Nuway Homes Texas, L.P.) and managing member of Nuway Holdings, L.L.C., all at the Colina office address: https://comptroller.texas.gov/data-search/franchise-tax/32033048748 and https://comptroller.texas.gov/data-search/franchise-tax/32071157054. Email: this address is the mailto target behind the 'info@colinahomes.com' link on the company's contact page (https://www.colinahomes.com/contact), not a displayed address; it matches the first-initial-plus-last-name pattern the site publishes for sales staff. No direct phone published.
